---
title: "Inversiones"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Inversiones</h1><div class="tf-muted">Capital patrimonial, rendimiento y liquidez sin duplicar ingresos ni gastos.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem"><button id="inv-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nueva inversión</button><button id="inv-history-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Histórico</button></div>
<section class="tf-card"><div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th>Inversión</th><th>Institución</th><th class="tf-num">Saldo</th><th class="tf-num">Tasa</th><th>Liquidez</th><th>Fondo emergencia</th><th>Información</th></tr></thead><tbody id="inv-list"></tbody></table></div></section>

<dialog id="inv-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Inversión</div><h2 id="inv-editor-title">Nueva inversión</h2></div><button id="inv-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="inv-form" class="tf-form-grid"><input id="inv-id" type="hidden"><div class="tf-field"><label>Banco / institución</label><input id="inv-bank" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Nombre</label><input id="inv-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Capital inicial ($)</label><input id="inv-principal" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tasa anual (%)</label><input id="inv-rate" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Tipo de tasa</label><select id="inv-rate-type"><option value="nominal">Nominal</option><option value="effective">Efectiva</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cálculo</label><select id="inv-calc"><option value="simple">Interés simple</option><option value="compound">Capitalización</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Capitalización</label><select id="inv-cap"><option value="monthly">Mensual</option><option value="quarterly">Trimestral</option><option value="semiannual">Semestral</option><option value="annual">Anual</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Inicio</label><input id="inv-start" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Plazo</label><input id="inv-term" type="number" min="1" value="12"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Unidad</label><select id="inv-unit"><option value="days">Días</option><option value="months">Meses</option><option value="years">Años</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Retenciones esperadas ($)</label><input id="inv-withholding" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Comisiones ($)</label><input id="inv-fees" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta origen del capital</label><select id="inv-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta que contiene la inversión (opcional)</label><select id="inv-holding-account"></select><small class="tf-muted">Si la inversión es una cuenta real del tracker, los aportes se registran como transferencias entre cuentas y este saldo no se duplica en el Fondo de emergencia.</small></div><label class="tf-check"><input id="inv-historical" type="checkbox"> Capital histórico previo al tracker; no crear movimiento</label><div class="tf-field"><label>Liquidez</label><select id="inv-liquidity"><option value="immediate">Inmediata</option><option value="restricted">Restringida / rescate con condición</option><option value="maturity">Solo al vencimiento</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Penalización por retiro</label><select id="inv-penalty"><option value="none">Ninguna</option><option value="lost_interest">Pierde intereses generados</option><option value="other">Otra penalización</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fondo de emergencia</label><select id="inv-emergency"><option value="none">No incluir</option><option value="immediate">Disponible inmediato</option><option value="secondary">Reserva secundaria</option></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Aporte programado mensual ($, opcional)</label><input id="inv-recurring-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Día del aporte</label><input id="inv-recurring-day" type="number" min="1" max="31" value="1"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Recordar vencimiento (días antes)</label><input id="inv-reminder" type="number" min="0" max="365" value="15"></div><div class="tf-span-2"><div id="inv-preview-box" class="tf-subtle"></div></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button id="inv-preview" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Calcular</button><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar</button><button id="inv-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="inv-contribution-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Inversión</div><h2 id="inv-contribution-title">Registrar aporte</h2></div><button id="inv-contribution-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="inv-contribution-form" class="tf-form-grid"><input id="contribution-investment" type="hidden"><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="contribution-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta origen</label><select id="contribution-account" required></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto ($)</label><input id="contribution-amount" type="number" min="0.01" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-muted">El aporte reduce la cuenta bancaria y aumenta la inversión. No se registra como gasto.</div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar aporte</button><button id="inv-contribution-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="inv-settle-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Inversión</div><h2>Liquidar inversión</h2></div><button id="settle-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="inv-settle-form" class="tf-form-grid"><input id="settle-investment" type="hidden"><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta destino</label><select id="settle-account" required></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="settle-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Capital retornado ($)</label><input id="settle-principal" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Rendimiento neto real ($)</label><input id="settle-interest" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-muted">El capital retornado no es ingreso. Solo el rendimiento neto se registra como ingreso financiero.</div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Liquidar</button><button id="settle-cancel" type="button" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary">Cancelar</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="inv-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Inversión</div><h2 id="inv-detail-title">Información</h2></div><button id="inv-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><div id="inv-detail-body"></div></dialog>
<script type="module" src="js/investments.js?v=1.0.89"></script>
```
